data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss activity during the calendar year and favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves. ... This book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release of prior-year gross reserves of approximately GBP 54.0m (a ~9.1% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 590.8m). The reduction is driven by favourable claims development and benign loss experience in Property and US Casualty portfolios, as noted in the report. No single quantified prior-year gross strengthening was reported; the report describes releases from prior years and limited loss activity as the primary drivers.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves.
it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.
loss experience continues to be relatively benign

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) by summing changes for underwriting years 2011-2013 (excluding the aggregate '2010 and prior' column and excluding the two most recent years 2014-2015). The triangle in the PDF was sparsely printed and required alignment interpretation; amounts are therefore estimated from the parsed development rows and the reserves + cumulative payments reconciliation. Opening gross claims outstanding is taken directly from the Balance Sheet (liabilities). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was present; net narrative references to releases are present. Confidence reflects reconstruction from the triangle (0.8).
